context_budget.bootstrap: read this entry, target A7_MODULE.json, and one relevant owner policy
context_budget.avoid: whole Drive scan / all control towers / chat transcripts unless fact-specific conflict

provider_roles.git: Source code, executable configurations, peer module definitions, source-history diffs, PR reviews, branch snapshots, CI results and deployment provenance.
provider_roles.google_drive: Research documents, original scanned/office content, native Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, compiled PDF/PPTX/DOCX, restricted evidence and stable provider IDs.
provider_roles.a7: Global public-safe authority resolution, semantic identities, repository/module routing, versioned machine contracts and typed cross-provider relationships.
provider_roles.module: Project facts/data and domain-specific source/manifests remain owned by the respective project/module.
provider_roles.main_library: Private Drive-based discovery catalog and artifact/edge/event projection, not a duplicate Git history.
provider_roles.chatgpt: Runtime resolver/operator; must fetch live GitHub/Drive objects; cannot magically load these instructions across all chats without an active workflow or connector.

policy_resolution: exact module control and repository A7_MODULE.json
project control/source manifest in owning provider

version_control.git: Commit history; feature branch is entire repository snapshot, not a folder or researcher-only database. Tagged releases when needed.
version_control.drive: Native revision and stable document IDs; snapshot/archives only when original must be changed without reliable rollback, when a project-specific control requires, or for material regulated changes.
version_control.no_unbounded_versions: Do not create new Drive duplicates or sequences solely to acknowledge Git commits.
version_control.migration: Keep Drive originals and old A9 controls until specific safe replacement is independently verified.

write_and_readback: read minimal live source and current git commit
snapshot provider-native state before material mutation
record Git commit SHA and Drive ID/revision into per-module manifest/ledger
run owner validation and Pages/workflow when applicable
report open debts and unresolved migrations
privacy: A7 and current peer GitHub repositories are PUBLIC. Never publish secrets, private Drive corpus, personal credentials, raw financial/construction evidence, copyrighted originals, private font files or restricted documents.
